source: UN Comtrade 2022 imports (flowCode M, CIF) by partner and HS2 as China's customs reports them (data/un_comtrade_import_floor_2022/M_156); CIF/FOB is the v4 CHN goods VCIF/VFOB (S07 VXSB plus S08 VTWR)
decided_by: Claude (beta v5 B; David approved the v5 package 2026-10-27 08:39 UTC)
basis: Beta v5 B (trade-balance trace A1): CHN goods imports in BACI are short of China's own customs (CHN 2,178 FOB against 2,716 CIF), mostly partners' under-reported exports (TWN, MYS, KOR electronics). Imports from other regions outside HS 27 (S11 rebuilds energy) and HS 71 (precious metals, a caveat), and HS 99 (not on any BACI HS6 line), are raised to the own-customs total of those lines, on the partner x HS2 cells where the importer reports more. Re-imports (partner = the importer) are left out. GTAP 7 ch.9A pp.9A-1 to 9A-3 keeps the more reliable report; choosing the importer's customs for these two is our choice, a labelled departure.
